# Splunk Help

> Documentation and resources for Splunk Enterprise Security, covering release notes, features, and platform compatibility across Splunk Enterprise and Splunk Cloud Platform.

This help site provides comprehensive documentation for Splunk's security solutions, including release information, feature updates, and guidance for Enterprise Security deployments. The documentation covers both Splunk Enterprise and Splunk Cloud Platform implementations.
